scope: Exactly five non-parametrised native declarations in tests/test_xlsx_dependency_preservation.py at the published v0.46 consumer revision. A native pass is not a shared workflow binding.

verifiedAspects: Copies the shared default-style workbook, patches A1 with first/newline/second into a distinct output and checks changes_applied equals 1.

Checks all input ZIP member payloads except sheet1.xml and styles.xml equal output payloads, reopens with openpyxl to read A1 and wrap_text, and checks each worksheet style index is below the output cellXfs count.
gaps: The native test does not assert unchanged whole-source bytes or independently validate every output relationship and content-type target; it checks only the two changed-part exclusions. Its openpyxl readback is not a separate application producer or rendering check.

verifiedAspects: Copies shared cross-sheet-cache.xlsx to a source path and commits Input!A1 numeric 10 to a distinct output; checks one change, recalculation-required and invalidate-all-formula-caches results.

Reopens with openpyxl twice: data_only reads Calc!A1 as None and formula mode reads =Input!A1*2; verifies Input!A1 is 10, forceFullCalc is 1, and all original ZIP member payloads outside two worksheets and workbook.xml equal the output.
gaps: The native test does not compare whole source bytes after the edit, independently check relationship/content-type target closure, or assert that output has no added members; those are separate shared outcomes.

A generated workbook edited in place retains B1 custom number format and right alignment while adding wrap text to A1. The shared style-dependency-closure case instead uses pinned default-style.xlsx, a distinct output, all style indices, relationship closure and member custody. No exact common predicate is registered for this generated-source custom-style preservation.

merge_styles directly rejects changing an existing XF fontId with ValueError matching registry rewrite. The shared cell-style-refusal cases attempt existing cell-style selection in a package with atomic byte and cache custody; this unit helper test does not exercise that operation or its package rollback.

verifiedAspects: Injects a standard-path xl/calcChain.xml part, one workbook relationship and one content-type override into the shared cross-sheet cache ZIP; after in-place Input!A1 edit to 10, checks one change and absence of the chain part and calcChain tokens in the workbook relationships and content types.
gaps: The canonical case uses a coherent nonstandard xl/chains/order.xml owned chain with two dependent formula entries, saves and reopens, checks source bytes, both formula texts and empty caches, a data-only stale-read boundary, unrelated cached C1=42, recalculation flags, graph closure and unrelated member custody. This native test asserts none of those outcomes and uses a standard-path injected chain with a single A1 entry. It is not a canonical binding or execution credit.
